bagPolicy.summary: Bags no larger than 12″ x 12″ x 6″ are allowed and will be screened. Backpacks of all sizes are prohibited, but medical and baby bags are permitted with screening.
allowed: Bags no larger than 12″ x 12″ x 6″
prohibited: Patrons without shoes, shirts, or pants/shorts
Flowers, unless allowed by tour production
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions will be made for those with medical requirements and/or special needs.

parking.note: Parking is available for purchase prior to events via ParkWhiz and Ticketmaster, with prices increasing by $5-$10 at the arena. General paid parking is available at Emerald Parking, with additional lots accessible via the Cross Island Parkway.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in UBS Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: UBS Arena offers a diverse range of dining options with 12 market-style outlets featuring hot, freshly prepared foods, ready-to-go meals, and self-serve snacks and beverages. Highlights include vegetarian, gluten-free, and kosher options, as well as unique offerings like the 'Fear the Schmear' Porkbelly and Habanero Sandwich and Benihana Hibachi Bowls.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair seating is located in each of the following sections: 103, 104, 105, 109, 112, 114, 115, 117, 205, 210, 214, 217, 222. Also, if ASL interpreter services are needed, we recommend sitting at an accessible platform, located at the following Sections: 103, 104, 105, 109, 112, 114, 115, 117.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in UBS Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at UBS Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at UBS Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
